instruction: I have a list of people I owe money to, including amounts and descriptions, in owe_list.csv. For each person, (1) If they have a Venmo account, send the money privately with the specified amount and description. (2) If not, create an individual (non-grouped) Splitwise expense with the same details so I remember to pay them later. For Splitwise expenses, attach the PDF receipt as well. They are in the same folder as the CSV file.
notes: The CSV contents are unknown at modeling time, so the problem encodes a representative scenario of three owed people (owee-1..3, declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can enumerate the per-person goal conditions without extra parameters): two have Venmo accounts and one does not. (has-venmo-account ?p), (owes ...), (person-email ...) and (receipt-for ...) are static world facts; the agent only learns them through file_system.show_directory (recursive=true, locates owe_list.csv and the PDF receipts beside it), file_system.show_file (reads rows) and venmo.search_users (query = the person's email; empty result means no account). Each row is handled by exactly one branch: venmo.create_transaction with private=true for Venmo users, or a non-grouped splitwise.record_expense (payer = the person, debtor_emails = [supervisor email], no group_id) with the PDF attached inline via receipt_file_path + file_system_access_token for the rest. No answer is passed to complete_task. Plan length matches the 13-call reference.
